name: FCC 152 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 152, a lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc152-hubble
story: FCC 152 sits near the border between lenticular and spiral galaxies, a transition type among the 43 early-type galaxies Hubble surveyed in the Fornax Cluster.

claims.text: FCC 152 is a lenticular galaxy observed by the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey
FCC 152 is also ESO 358-G25, type S0/a pec
FCC 152 is an S0/a transition-type galaxy
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax Cluster with Hubble
The survey was designed to study the role of environment
